newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Trinity Industries estimate lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Trinity Industries estimate lowered.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc Thursday lowered its estimate for Trinity Industries Inc's third-quarter earnings to $0.77 from $0.78 and the estimate for the fourth quarter to $0.69 from $0.75.
-- Hanifen cited a move by the company to lower its railcar production because of continued soft orders.
-- Hanifen also lowered its estimate for fiscal 1998 earnings to $3.50 from $3.65 and maintained its hold rating for Trinity Industries, a maker of railcars, construction and marine products.
-- The company's shares closed up 1/4 Thursday at 35-3/8.
